description: Indicative Ferry Routes - Orkney Islands is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. This is a line dataset depicting Indicative ferry routes for the ferries servicing the Orkney Islands. Routes are used by Orkney Ferries, Northlink and Pentland Ferries as identified in the Orkney Islands Regional Marine Plan. It has been captured as one single feature. Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Ferry, Routing, Transport networks. The portal shows 2024-06-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
